final: WITH rc AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, r.round FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), cavg AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS circuit_avg FROM rc GROUP BY circuitId, country), kavg AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS country_avg FROM rc GROUP BY country) SELECT cavg.circuitId, cavg.country, cavg.circuit_avg, cavg.circuit_avg - kavg.country_avg AS diff FROM cavg JOIN kavg ON kavg.country = cavg.country ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
